title: Getting started with basemapper
text: Every function takes style: MapLibre GL style (URL, file JSON), named basemap ("CartoDB.Voyager", "Esri.WorldImagery": leaflet-providers names), tile data, whose style built : tile URL, TileJSON, PMTiles archive (URL local file) ArcGIS service. vector styles stacked bottom top. list_layers() lists style’s layers (id type) drawing order:
code: library(basemapper)  list_providers()                  # name, forms, API key variable, attribution positron <- "OpenFreeMap.Positron"  # a name works as a style positron <- providers$OpenFreeMap.Positron   # the same, with autocompletion  # Pick the form of a basemap that has both; CARTO, MapTiler and Stadia need # a free API key (api_key =, or CARTO_API_KEY etc.) gray <- basemap_provider("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas", type = "raster")  # Your own tiles with a basemap's style (same schema, here OpenMapTiles) mine <- basemap_provider("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", tiles = "data/omt.pmtiles")  # Tile data works as a style directly osm  <- "https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png" esri <- "https://basemaps.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/World_Basemap_v2/VectorTileServer" area <- "data/area.pmtiles"   # raster or vector, read from the archive  # tile_style() overrides what is detected, e.g. the paint of the default # vector style, or which source layers it draws mvt <- tile_style("https://example.com/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.mvt", source_layers = "land",                   paint = list("fill-color" = "#e8e0d8", "line-color" = "#aaaaaa"))  # OGC services relief <- wms_style("https://example.com/wms", layers = "relief") list_layers(positron)

what: Step 2 — A map on its own
title: Getting started with basemapper
text: basemap() creates view: centre MapLibre zoom, bounds fit. width height CSS pixels; pixel_ratio makes image larger view label layout (pixel_ratio = 2 sharp 2x image, dpi / 96 print). Change view set_view() set_bounds(), read get_bounds(), get_center(), get_zoom() get_size():
code: m <- basemap(positron, 800, 600, center = c(-111.8887, 40.7556), zoom = 12.4,              pixel_ratio = 2) m #> <basemap> 1 style, 800 x 600 @ 2x (1600 x 1200 px), center (-111.88870, 40.75560), zoom 12.400  render_png(m, path = "slc.png") render_svg(m, path = "slc.svg")   # true vector, labels as editable text r <- render_raster(m)             # terra SpatRaster in EPSG:3857 a <- render_array(m)              # [1200, 1600, 4] integer array nc <- sf::st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE) m <- set_bounds(m, nc)            # fit an sf object's extent get_zoom(m) get_bounds(m, lonlat = TRUE) m <- set_view(m, zoom = get_zoom(m) + 1)

title: Getting started with basemapper
text: geom_basemap() renders plot drawn, panel’s extent device’s resolution, ggsave(dpi = 300) gets basemap rendered 300 dpi:
code: library(ggplot2)  ggplot(nc) +   geom_basemap(positron) +   geom_sf(fill = NA, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.4) +   coord_sf() +   theme_void()

code: library(tmap)  tm_shape(nc) +   tm_basemap(positron) +   tm_borders(col = "steelblue")

title: Getting started with basemapper
text: labels = FALSE draws style without labels (text icons); labels = "" draws just labels, transparent background, go another map. features keeps drops parts map show: background, water, landcover, parks, buildings, roads, rail, boundaries, places, poi terrain. list_layers() shows layer’s feature. renderers apply every style stack. filter one style stack, pass basemap_provider(); puts satellite imagery vector basemap’s labels: Features convenience, sorted layer’s source layer (see source_layer feature columns list_layers()). exact control, pass layer IDs layers keep layers, prefix IDs "-" drop ; * ? wildcards. Keeping dropping mixed. Names match layer warn. Tiles cached disk (tile_cache() shows , moves cache clears ), long servers’ caching headers allow. Basemap providers ask maps credit . plot layers draw credit line bottom-right corner (attribution = FALSE turns , attribution = "..." replaces ), get_attribution() returns , caption:
code: list_layers(positron)                       # id, type, source_layer, feature list_layers(positron, labels = FALSE, features = c("water", "roads"))   # preview  # Water and roads only, without their names render_png(basemap(positron, 800, 600, bounds = nc, labels = FALSE,                    features = c("water", "roads")), path = "nc-lines.png")  # Everything but buildings and points of interest ggplot(nc) + geom_basemap(positron, features = c("-buildings", "-poi")) hybrid <- c("Esri.WorldImagery",             basemap_provider("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", labels = "only")) render_png(basemap(hybrid, 800, 600, bounds = nc), path = "nc-hybrid.png")  # Raster basemaps switch to their label-free or label-only tiles relief <- c("Esri.WorldShadedRelief", basemap_provider("Esri.WorldShadedRelief", labels = "only")) # Without town and village labels render_png(basemap(positron, 800, 600, bounds = nc, layers = c("-label_town", "-label_village")),            path = "nc.png")  ggplot(nc) + geom_basemap(positron, layers = c("background", "water")) ggplot(nc) +   geom_basemap(positron, attribution = FALSE) +   geom_sf(fill = NA) +   labs(caption = get_attribution(positron))

text: map view render headlessly: one style, several stacked. view centre MapLibre zoom (512 px tiles; fractional zooms rendered natively, resampled), bounds fit. width height CSS pixels; images pixel_ratio times larger view label layout (MapLibre's devicePixelRatio): pixel_ratio = 2 gives sharp 2x image, pixel_ratio = dpi / 96 matches print resolution.

title: Create a basemap view — basemap
code: basemap(   style,   width = 800L,   height = 600L,   center = NULL,   zoom = NULL,   bounds = NULL,   crs = NULL,   pixel_ratio = 1,   layers = NULL,   labels = TRUE,   features = NULL,   auth_token = NULL,   tile_timeout_ms = 10000L,   max_tiles = 256L,   tile_concurrency = 16L,   fail_on_tile_error = FALSE )

title: Create a basemap view — basemap
text: style MapLibre GL style URL JSON string (e.g. basemap_provider()), character vector / list stacked bottom top (e.g. basemap published separate hillshade, base label services). width, height View size CSS pixels. center c(longitude, latitude) view centre. zoom MapLibre zoom (0–22, fractional allowed). bounds Bounds fit instead center/zoom: c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) crs (default EPSG:4326), sf::st_bbox() result, sf / sfc object. crs CRS bounds (anything sf::st_crs() accepts). pixel_ratio Device pixels per CSS pixel. layers Optional layer filter applied every style: plain IDs keep layers, minus-prefixed IDs drop ; * ? wildcards ("-label_*"). See list_layers(). Names match layer style warn. labels TRUE keeps every layer, FALSE drops labels (text icons), "" keeps labels transparent background, stack another map. Catalogue raster basemaps switch label-free label-tiles. features Optional feature filter applied every style: plain names keep features, minus-prefixed names drop , e.g. c("water", "roads") "-buildings". Features: background, water, landcover, parks, buildings, roads, rail, boundaries, places, poi, terrain, (feature column list_layers()). Features layer style belongs warn. auth_token Optional access token tile service. tile_timeout_ms Per-tile HTTP timeout milliseconds. max_tiles Maximum tiles fetched per style. tile_concurrency Parallel tile downloads. fail_on_tile_error Abort failed tile instead leaving empty.

title: basemapper: Headless Spatial Basemap Renderer — basemapper-package
text: Renders MapLibre GL styled basemaps (vector raster tiles) headlessly Rust core: software port MapLibre GL JS's renderer, tested pixel pixel MapLibre GL JS. Renders fractional zoom pixel ratio PNG, rasters arrays, true vector SVG; several styles can stacked. Integrates ggplot2 via geom_basemap() tmap v4 via tm_basemap(), rendering output device's resolution.

title: Named basemaps — basemap_provider
text: basemap_provider() returns style named basemap, basemap() renderers' style argument. Names follow leaflet-providers ("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery", "OpenStreetMap.HOT"); list_providers() lists forms, providers completes . name also works style directly; use function pick form, pass key, draw tiles basemap's style. Implemented Rust core, R Python (basemapper.basemap_provider()) return style.

title: Named basemaps — basemap_provider
code: basemap_provider(   name,   type = NULL,   api_key = NULL,   tiles = NULL,   labels = TRUE,   features = NULL )

title: Named basemaps — basemap_provider
text: name Basemap name (case-insensitive). type "vector" (MapLibre style) "raster" (tiles). default vector form one, else raster. Asking form basemap lacks error, never silent fallback. api_key API key CARTO, MapTiler Stadia; default read CARTO_API_KEY, MAPTILER_API_KEY STADIA_API_KEY. keys free moderate use; list_providers() shows basemaps need one. tiles tile data draw basemap's style: .pmtiles archive (URL path), tile URL TileJSON. must use schema provider's tiles (OpenMapTiles OpenFreeMap Stadia). labels TRUE keeps every layer, FALSE drops labels, "" keeps labels, stack basemap's labels another map. Raster tiles switch provider's label-free label-tiles (error none). features Vector form: features keep (c("water", "roads")) drop ("-buildings"); see list_layers().

title: Named basemaps — basemap_provider
text: style string: URL, inline style JSON (raster form, tiles, labels features).

title: Named basemaps — basemap_provider
